parole.significato: sultan (hereditary ruler in certain Muslim states called sultanates)
parole.testo: Via other European languages (compare French sultan, German Sultan), ultimately borrowed from Turkish sultan, itself from Arabic سُلْطَان (sulṭān), apparently from Aramaic [script needed] (šultānā, “strength, power, authority”).

parole.significato: a Turk, a Turkish man, a man from Turkey or of Turkish descent
parole.testo: Via various European languages, ultimately from Turkish Türk (“Turk”), of unknown origin.
Ultimately from Turkish çakal, from Persian شغال (šaġâl), from Sanskrit सृगाल (sṛgālá).
